scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus leads his disciples past a rocky stream toward an opening in a flowering garden, under a moonlit sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus and his disciples entering a garden beyond the Kidron winter stream in John 18:1; the appearance of the place and people is imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with disciples beneath a broad tree in a sunlit landscape, while Judas stands apart and looks back toward the gathering.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the place Judas knew because Jesus often gathered there with His disciples; the setting and poses are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed Judas leads a group of soldiers and officers along a rocky path at night, with glowing lanterns, flaming torches, and spears lighting the trees around them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:3: Judas comes with a cohort and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons. The landscape and appearances are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus steps forward and gestures toward a group of men beneath trees at dusk, with torches lighting the scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus going forth and asking whom they seek, knowing what was coming upon Him. The setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures calmly toward a group of men standing beneath trees by lantern and torchlight, with a man in a golden shawl among them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 18:5: the group answers Jesus and he replies; Judas, who is delivering him up, stands with them. The setting, clothing, expressions and lighting are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with one hand extended as a group of men recoil and fall to the ground among trees, stones, and torchlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:6: when he says “I am,” those addressed draw back and fall to the ground. The setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a light robe gestures toward a group of men, one of whom answers him, in a torchlit landscape at night.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of the exchange in John 18:7, where he asks again whom they seek and they answer Jesus of Nazareth. The setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward his companions as he faces a group of men carrying torches, while the companions move along a path behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 18:8: Jesus identifies himself to those seeking him and asks that the others be allowed to go away. The setting, appearances and gestures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with his arms around a close gathering of followers beneath a tree, with a sunlit landscape and village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus keeping those given to him together, reflecting the verse’s account of his fulfilled word that he lost not one of them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a drawn sword looks toward another man who recoils and holds the right side of his head, with torchbearers behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 18:10, in which Simon Peter draws a sword and cuts off the right ear of Malchus, the high priest's servant. The setting and appearances are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures calmly toward Peter, who lowers a sword into its sheath beneath olive trees at night, while torchbearers stand in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus telling Peter to put the sword into its sheath and speaking of the cup the Father has given him to drink, in John 18:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among soldiers and officers in a lantern-lit outdoor setting as a soldier binds his wrists with rope; a commander watches nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:12, in which the cohort, commander and officers of the Jews take hold of Jesus and bind him. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, his hands bound, is escorted by several men toward an older man standing in the illuminated doorway of a stone residence.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus being led first to Annas, whom the verse identifies as the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Caiaphas gestures as he addresses a group of listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard; a solitary man stands near a gathering of people beyond them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Caiaphas giving the counsel recalled in John 18:14, that it was profitable for one man to perish for the people. The courtyard and figures illustrate the idea and are not details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm, torchlit stone courtyard, Jesus walks near an open gate with another disciple close behind; Simon Peter follows farther back, while a guard stands by the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:15: Simon Peter and another disciple follow Jesus, and the disciple known to the high priest enters the high priest’s courtyard with Jesus. The setting and appearances are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a warmly lit stone doorway, the other disciple gestures toward the entrance as Peter approaches from outside and a woman doorkeeper holds the door.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:16: Peter stands outside, the other disciple speaks to the doorkeeper and brings him in. The figures and setting are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone doorway, a young woman holding a torch looks questioningly toward Peter, who raises his hands and looks uneasy; figures gather in a courtyard behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the doorkeeper questioning Peter about being a disciple and his denial in John 18:17. The setting, gestures, and other visual details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Men in robes and a helmeted officer gather around glowing coals in a stone courtyard, warming their hands in the cold; a central figure stands among them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:18: servants and officers warm themselves at a coal fire in the cold, and Peter stands with them warming himself. The setting and appearances are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit stone room, a richly robed high priest gestures toward Jesus, who stands calmly facing him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:19, where the high priest questions Jesus about his disciples and his teaching; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits on stone steps and teaches a gathered group in a sunlit temple courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus teaching publicly in the temple, reflecting his answer that he spoke openly and taught where people gathered.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a group of listeners while speaking to a questioning man in a warmly lit stone room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:21: Jesus directs the questioner to ask those who heard what he said. The setting and the hearers' presence are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a stone hall, an armored officer strikes Jesus on the cheek with an open hand as a seated high priest and others look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:22, where an officer standing by strikes Jesus with his palm and challenges how he answered the high priest. The setting, clothing, and figures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a stern man whose hand is lowered, in a warmly lit stone interior; an armed figure stands in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering the man and asking him to testify if Jesus spoke wrongly, or explain why he strikes him if he spoke rightly. The setting and appearances are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, his wrists bound, is escorted across a stone courtyard as Annas gestures behind him and Caiaphas waits at a doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Annas sending Jesus bound to Caiaphas the high priest. The setting, figures, and details of the journey are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter stands by a glowing fire in a stone courtyard, warming one hand and raising the other as several people question him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:25: Simon Peter warms himself, is asked whether he is one of Jesus’ disciples, and denies it. The courtyard and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a firelit stone courtyard, a bearded servant gestures as he questions a second bearded man, Peter, who looks back anxiously; trees rise against the night sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the high priest's servant questioning Peter about having seen him in the garden with Jesus, as described in John 18:26. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter raises his hands toward a man in a stone courtyard as a rooster crows nearby in the early light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 18:27, where Peter denies again and a rooster immediately crows. The courtyard and surrounding details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At dawn, Jesus is led toward the stone entrance of the praetorium while a group of men remains outside, watching from the street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 18:28: Jesus is led from Caiaphas to the praetorium early in the morning, while those who brought him stay outside so they may eat the Passover without being defiled. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate steps outside a stone building and gestures toward a group of men listening on the steps, with guards behind him and a sunlit city in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Pilate going outside and asking what accusation the people bring against the man in John 18:29. The setting, clothing, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group of robed men gesture toward a seated official as a quiet man stands between them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the exchange in John 18:30: the speakers say they would not have delivered the man if he were not doing evil. The scene illustrates their accusation without presenting it as fact.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward a group of Jewish men in a sunlit stone courtyard while a calm man stands nearby and one of the men responds with open hands.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the exchange in John 18:31: Pilate tells them to judge the man according to their law, and they say they are not permitted to put anyone to death.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive listeners beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape, with an empty wooden cross on a distant hill.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking and a distant cross foreshadowing his death. John 18:32 speaks of the fulfillment of his words signifying the kind of death he was about to die; it does not describe this gathering.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate, seated in a sunlit Roman hall, gestures toward Jesus as two soldiers stand nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 18:33, when Pilate calls Jesus in the praetorium and asks whether he is the King of the Jews. The setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands, speaking to a thoughtful man in red across a sunlit stone room; a guard stands in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus asking whether the man speaks from himself or from what others told him concerning Jesus. The setting, clothing, and other figures are artistic choices; the English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward Jesus as he questions him in a sunlit stone setting, while a Roman guard and chief priests stand behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Pilate questioning Jesus after saying that Jesus’ own nation and the chief priests delivered him to Pilate, as described in John 18:35. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a seated official in a sunlit stone courtyard, while two guards stand quietly nearby and a landscape appears through an arch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus' answer that his kingdom is not from this world and that his attendants would otherwise fight to prevent his being handed over. The courtyard, listeners, and distant landscape are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a seated Pilate, who listens thoughtfully in a sunlit Roman chamber, with guards nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering Pilate's question about kingship and speaking of his witness to the truth and those who hear his voice in John 18:37. The setting and poses are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward a group outside a stone residence while Jesus stands inside behind him, in a warm watercolor illustration.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Pilate going out to the Jewish people and saying he finds no guilt in Jesus, after asking Him what truth is. The setting and figures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A Roman official gestures toward Jesus as a guard stands nearby and a gathered crowd listens in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the question in John 18:39 about the Passover custom of releasing one person and whether the people wish the King of the Jews to be released.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a crowd cries out and points toward a guarded, chained man, while a calm robed Jesus stands apart.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 18:40: the crowd cries out for Barabbas rather than the other man, and the verse identifies Barabbas as an insurrectionist. The setting, appearances and arrangement are artistic interpretation.
